targets.name: matmul_2x2_z
targets.title: 2x2 Matrix Multiplication over Z
targets.summary: Find an exact bilinear rank decomposition (u, v, w) for 2x2 matrix multiplication over the integers Z with rank < holder.
targets.approach: Submit a JSON decomposition {target, ring, m, k, n, rank, u, v, w} over Z with strictly smaller rank than the current holder.

targets.name: matmul_3x3_f2
targets.title: 3x3 Matrix Multiplication over GF(2)
targets.summary: Find an exact bilinear rank decomposition (u, v, w) for 3x3 matrix multiplication over GF(2) with rank < holder.
targets.approach: Submit a JSON decomposition {target, ring, m, k, n, rank, u, v, w} over GF(2) with entries in {0, 1} and rank strictly smaller than holder.
